findings.description: Incorrect handling of duplicate keys: the function keeps the last occurrence instead of the first, contrary to the spec which requires the first item for each distinct key.
findings.evidence: candidate.unique_by([(1,'a'),(1,'b')], lambda x: x[0]) returns ['(1,'b')'] but the contract specifies the output should be ['(1,'a')'].

review.summary: The candidate implementation violates the contract by returning the last item per key instead of the first, producing incorrect results when duplicate keys map to different items.
